title: Python Release Python 3.15.0 | Python.org
text:
Python Release Python 3.15.0 | Python.org

# Python 3.15.0

 Note: Python 3.15.0 has been superseded by Python 3.15.2. 

Release date: Oct. 9, 2026

## This is the stable release of Python 3.15.0

Python 3.15.0 is the newest major release of the Python programming language, and it contains many new features and optimisations compared to Python 3.14, in 5,643 commits from 1,012 contributors.

title: History of Python
text: As of October 2026, Python 3.15 is the latest stable release. This version currently receives full bug-fix and security updates, while Python 3.14—released in October 2025—will continue to receive bug-fixes until October 2027, and after that will only receive security fixes until its end-of-life in 2030. Python 3.11 is the oldest supported branch of Python (albeit in the 'security support' phase). [12] [13]

title: Python 3.15.1, 3.14.9 and 3.13.17 are out | Python Insider
text:
# Python 3.15.1, 3.14.9 and 3.13.17 are out

Hugo van Kemenade/ October 21, 2026

Here are expedited security releases of Python 3.15 and 3.14, and a special security release of 3.13.

- Python 3.15.1
- Python 3.14.9
- Python 3.13.17

They all upgrade the bundled pip to version 26.2.2, which includes certifi 2026.10.19 to address the eMudhra / emSign CA certificate security incident.

## This is the ninth maintenance release of Python 3.14

Python 3.14.9 is an expedited security release and the ninth maintenance release of 3.14, containing around 168 bugfixes, build improvements and documentation changes from 74 contributors since 3.14.8.

...
